out.t: Notifications Which automatic emails and notifications each department sends to customers, CC'd users, agents and teams, and the email template each one uses. Notification rules Resolution confirmation Department Customer Support Rules are set per department. A notification is sent only while its rule is on. A rule with no template of its own sends the built-in template, or the one activated under Email Templates. SMS Lets Desk send text messages, such as SMS activity reminders. The SMS provider is connected once for the whole platform; here you choose whether Desk may use it. SMS is switched off for Desk. Contact Notifications No SMS gateway is configured on this platform. Receiving a new ticket Notifies the requester that their ticket has been received. Setting it here decides for this department, whatever Channels → Email says.
